QUOTE: Events go into `event_queue_` under `event_mutex_`, and callbacks run on the engine thread via `process_events()` (`:118`, called from `server_manager.cpp:710`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the health monitor queues events under a mutex and callbacks are drained on the engine (caller) thread via process_events(), not run on the monitor thread.
